claims: The generic Composition.TranslationValidation instance is explicitly constructed in the required native-to-proof direction for all four native basic blocks, actual byte-decoded canonical relational instructions and actual B29 executions.

Every related native block has matching ordered memory/fault events and a successor related by equality of the entire native architecture, not just live values or final memory. Both branch successors, all input read faults, modular64bit pointer arithmetic and all first-store fault outcomes are covered without result/permission/branch premises.

Proof macro-boundaries erase to actual accepted-B instruction executions; their ghost tags retain the real branch history. The store-end ghost snapshot copies only the actual incoming B r1 before it is killed. Immutable native invocation fields persist through every constructor. No new ISA semantics, runtime guard or helper is introduced.

Native block fault status is recorded as terminal control state; failed accesses retain their exact partial architecture and fault event. The unchanged separate instruction-prefix theorem handles every finite native prefix and terminal-fault repeats.

validated_architectural_execution composes the explicit TV instance across arbitrary finite block executions, with full endpoint reconstruction and a real accepted-B execution having exactly the same effects.

bound_block_effects_checked composes that TV instance, assumed accepted-proof verifier soundness/admitted entry, and complete Artifact equality. The native relation reads the executed artifact native bytes/entry, and the verifier relation reads the accepted artifact proof bytes; equality also binds ABI and specialization metadata.

validation.dependency_scope: Focused new block module imports checked observer/state/B29 and unchanged canonical reference dependencies. The reproduction target includes prerequisites; this focused pass does not relabel a new full formal run.

premises: Initial native PC0/BPF PC0 active, same context argument and exact memory, supported bound native SP input; permissions, branch choices, store results and native successors are not supplied.
The canonical instruction/CFG relation uses exact P60 payload bytes, excluding the terminal RET stripped during checked materialization; first fault terminates a block.
Actual accepted B29 bytes and declared XDP expansion at PCs1/2; verifier soundness for that physical artifact and admitted entry is assumed.
The bound composition explicitly requires exact native image, proof image, entry0 and full executed/validated Artifact equality including ABI and specialization metadata.
trusted: Verifier soundness for the accepted physical B and its admitted entry; the declared context-conversion relation must describe that physical artifact.
The single V reference ISA/Memory semantics, whose hardware fidelity is validated separately by F and is not established by this theorem.
Kernel binding/entry/ABI/metadata enforcement and capture/platform provenance, including XDP conversion.
Lean kernel, propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound and explicitly audited Lean.ofReduceBool.
remaining: Physical JIT prologue/payload/epilogue embedding, actual caller/context/stack provenance and hardware fidelity of the canonical reference; therefore this is not a whole-machine safe_native theorem.
Per-program certificates for every other micro and application program.
Generic automatic per-program block discovery/certificate generation and transport of this logical block instance to each captured kernel-loaded artifact beyond the exact simple P60/B29 pair.
